title: Ordinary completed-coefficient immersion and chart model records
statement: Fix the prime ell, finite extension E and independently sized schemes and coefficients of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Define ordinary ringed-site Modules, directRingMap, push, pull and adj from the projection-defined maps of [lem-tw-completed-coefficient-ringed-coherence] and the module-sheaf adjunction [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define Good, Image, Square, ImmersionSquare, Chart and Comparison as follows: Good means termwise flat and K-flat; Image is a universal left-derived functor with counit invertible on Good complexes; Square retains an ordinary pullback isomorphism and its sectionwise direct-image adjunction mate; ImmersionSquare additionally records exact immersion pullbacks and the derived square normalization; Chart records exact represented restriction, its direct and ordinary comparisons with mate equations, and its derived normalization; Comparison records their composite and its formula. Thus the records retain the computation counits, section maps, adjunction mate and normalization equations. Their mathematical values are unchanged by extraction into a separate vocabulary module. Rings is written directly as the existing completed ring sheaf, definitionally equal to its previous commutative-forgetful expression. Rings, pull and adj have irreducible boundaries, with local semireducibility for construction. Derived categories and flatness are [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]; represented chart localization is [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].
